title: Compare improvement effects at identified opportunities
statement: The Lessons and improvement Module shall prepare context-bound comparisons of an adopted improvement's actual triggering and later comparable observations, preserving adverse or missing support and explicit reassessment without claiming effectiveness from adoption or elapsed time.

what.problem: Adoption, reproduction success or elapsed time can be mistaken for effectiveness without comparable observations.
what.desired_outcome: Compare improvement effects at identified opportunities.

why.rationale: SR-038 requires this accountable MOD-009 contribution; source meaning, adoption and evidence authority must remain distinct.

stakeholders: Project decision owners and assurance assessors

conditions: During supported finding analysis, work preparation, proposal disposition or opportunity-based effect assessment as applicable; reconsider when the material basis changes.

contexts: MOD-009 contribution to MOD-017 IF-017 consumed by MOD-012; existing controlled-change, assurance and selected retention boundaries.

how.approach: Apply improvement.md to exact participant-supplied context and observations, preserve missing/contrary support, and confirm authority, adopted effects and retention through their existing owners.

how_much.scope: Complete allocated contribution to SR-038 within the declared finite project/activity/observation scope; no automatic causal discovery, policy adoption or universal effectiveness claim.

acceptance_criteria: Bind actual reproducible triggering results to the adopted version and criteria; nonreproducibility or an unperformed attempt cannot be reported as a correction result.

Identify the next comparable known activity after adoption with context/order/acquisition limits and compare recurrence, intended behavior and adverse effects against prepared criteria; do not hide an earlier comparable failure.
Distinguish no comparable opportunity from missing observations at one that occurred; both leave dependent effectiveness unassessed regardless of adoption or reproduction success.

Carry actual contrary, mixed and incomplete observations to separate assurance preparation with bounded conclusions; no universal duration, sample threshold or recurrence-prevention guarantee is implied.
On recurrence or material context/version/criterion change, explain affected current reliance and required reassessment while preserving original observations and their earlier bounded meaning.
constraints: Existing Learn contributor confirmation and topic/route custody remain applicable to their actual operations; Design approval does not execute them.

sources.basis: Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
